correctness.rationale: Every cyclic parameter range is treated. The 4-point ceiling uses a 16-event counting contradiction based on two adjacent center transitions; the dense cases follow exact neighborhood complements; a universal shattered pair handles all sparse cases; the r=2 radius obstruction uses four exhaustive templates and unique common neighbors; two explicit 8-row trace tables witness every r>=3, n>=2r+4 triple. The encoded standalone checker confirms 120 fully searched small parameter pairs, 2717 construction entries and 142 radius-two obstruction orders. Finite checks are support, not proof.

originality.rationale: The inspected Adler–Benediktsson–Macpherson text proves VC bounds for Johnson and Hamming graph edge relations, not radius-r powers of cycles. The inspected Coudert–Csikós–Ducoffe–Viennot text develops graph VC algorithms and mainly closed-neighborhood conventions, not the present uniform exact cyclic phase diagram. Recoverable own claims and semantic published findings about Hamming/triangular neighborhoods, cycle neighborhood topology, and cover-free cycle families neither state nor imply the sharp dimension-three threshold and n=8,r=2 exception. Published full-text inspection of a closely titled topological record was unavailable; its abstract describes homotopy, not shattering. Priority remains a qualified risk.

value.rationale: The theorem classifies a canonical two-parameter graph range system exactly, with a sharp and unusual exceptional n=8,r=2 point, nonmonotonicity with graph order, stable dimension three at higher radii, and a reusable cyclic-change budget proof. These exact structural thresholds are not a routine restatement of general graph VC dimension bounds.
